description: This source file defines the RestJsonParser class, which implements REST-JSON parsing functionality for services like Glacier and Elastic Transcoder within the AWS SDK. It extends AbstractRestParser and uses PayloadParserTrait to parse JSON response bodies into structured data.

classes.name: RestJsonParser
classes.description: Implements REST-JSON parsing for AWS services, handling JSON responses and converting them into service-specific structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with the given service description and optional JSON parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the JSON body from the response and merges the parsed data into the result array.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a JSON member from a stream and returns the structured data.
